This document is responding to Reviewer 2's comment 6 on paried ordination method selection. Here we used euclidean distance of clr-transformed datasets, and plotted PCoA ordination.

#Load packages
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(FUNGuildR)
library(Biostrings)
library(qiime2R)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggExtra)
library(ggalluvial)
```

#Load data
```{r}
#The PacBio fungi dataset with only the samples matched Illumina ITS2 dataset
ps_PacBio_Fungi_match <- readRDS("PacBio/ps_PacBio_Fungi_match_sklearn.rds")
tax_ITS <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_Fungi_match@tax_table)
metadata_ITS <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_Fungi_match@sam_data)
otu_ITS <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_Fungi_match@otu_table)

#The PacBio fungi dataset trimmed to ITS2 region with only samples match Illumina ITS2 dataset
ps_PacBio_ITS2_match <- readRDS("PacBio/ps_PacBio_ITS2_match.rds")
tax_pacbio_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_ITS2_match@tax_table)
metadata_pacbio_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_ITS2_match@sam_data)
otu_pacbio_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_PacBio_ITS2_match@otu_table)

#The cleaned Illumina ITS2 dataset
ps_Illumina_ITS2 <- readRDS("Illumina/ps_Illumina_ITS2_sklearn.rds")
tax_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_Illumina_ITS2@tax_table)
metadata_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_Illumina_ITS2@sam_data)
otu_ITS2 <- data.frame(ps_Illumina_ITS2@otu_table)
```

#Good's coverage ITS2
```{r}
#Good’s coverage = 1 - (singletons / total reads) per sample
goods_coverage <- function(ps) {
  mat <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) mat <- t(mat)
  # counts: taxa x samples
  singles <- colSums(mat == 1)
  totals  <- colSums(mat)
  tibble(sample_id = colnames(mat),
         goods = 1 - (singles / totals))
}

gc_its2 <- goods_coverage(ps_Illumina_ITS2)
summary(gc_its2$goods)

gc_its <- goods_coverage(ps_PacBio_Fungi_match)
summary(gc_its$goods)

#Low coverage outlier
low_cov <- gc_its2 %>% arrange(goods) %>% head(3)
low_cov

# decide a threshold (e.g., < 0.90); report n low-coverage samples
sum(gc_its2$goods < 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(gc_its$goods < 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)

# Optional: drop extremely low-coverage samples from ITS2 *and* their paired PacBio samples
drop_ids <- gc_its2 %>% filter(goods < 0.90) %>% pull(sample_id)
drop_ids
ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(ps_Illumina_ITS2) %in% drop_ids), ps_Illumina_ITS2)
ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt) > 0, ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt)
ps_PacBio_ITS_filt <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt), ps_PacBio_Fungi_match)
ps_PacBio_ITS_filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_PacBio_ITS_filt) > 0, ps_PacBio_ITS_filt)
ps_PacBio_ITS2_filt <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt), ps_PacBio_ITS2_match)
ps_PacBio_ITS2_filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_PacBio_ITS2_filt) > 0, ps_PacBio_ITS2_filt)

#Report coverage
n_total <- nrow(gc_its2)
n_ge95  <- sum(gc_its2$goods >= 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
paste0(n_ge95, "/", n_total, " (", round(100*n_ge95/n_total), "%) of ITS2 samples ≥ 0.95 coverage.")
```

#Prepare phyloseq objects
```{r}
ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt
ps_PacBio_ITS_filt

#Transform to relative abundance
ps_Illumina_ITS2_clr <- microbiome::transform(ps_Illumina_ITS2_filt,"clr")
ps_PacBio_Fungi_match_clr <- microbiome::transform(ps_PacBio_ITS_filt,"clr")

#Make sure sample name match
common_samples <- intersect(sample_names(ps_Illumina_ITS2_clr), 
                            sample_names(ps_PacBio_Fungi_match_clr))

ps_Illumina_common <- prune_samples(common_samples, ps_Illumina_ITS2_clr)
ps_PacBio_common   <- prune_samples(common_samples, ps_PacBio_Fungi_match_clr)

ps_Illumina_common <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_Illumina_common) > 0, ps_Illumina_common)
ps_PacBio_common   <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_PacBio_common) > 0, ps_PacBio_common)
```

##Fig 2b: Paired Ordination and PERMANOVA
```{r}
#Prepare data
sample_data(ps_Illumina_common)$Workflow <- "ITS2"
sample_data(ps_PacBio_common)$Workflow  <- "Full-length ITS"

sample_names(ps_Illumina_common) <- paste0(sample_names(ps_Illumina_common), "_Illumina")
sample_names(ps_PacBio_common)   <- paste0(sample_names(ps_PacBio_common), "_PacBio")

sample_data(ps_Illumina_common)$PairID <- gsub("_Illumina$", "", sample_names(ps_Illumina_common))
sample_data(ps_PacBio_common)$PairID   <- gsub("_PacBio$", "", sample_names(ps_PacBio_common))

taxa_names(ps_Illumina_common) <- paste0("ITS2_", taxa_names(ps_Illumina_common))
taxa_names(ps_PacBio_common)   <- paste0("ITSfull_", taxa_names(ps_PacBio_common))

ps_combined <- merge_phyloseq(ps_Illumina_common, ps_PacBio_common)
ps_combined <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_combined) > 0, ps_combined)

#Euclidean distance
dist.eu <- phyloseq::distance(ps_combined, method = "euclidean")

adonis2(
  dist.eu ~ Workflow + SampleType + Location,
  data = data.frame(sample_data(ps_combined)),
  permutations = 10000,
  strata = sample_data(ps_combined)$PairID,
  by = "terms"
)

#Plot
ord <- ordinate(ps_combined, method = "NMDS", distance = "euclidean")
paired_ordination <- plot_ordination(ps_combined, ord, color = "Workflow", shape = "SampleType") + 
   geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
   facet_wrap(~ Location) + 
   stat_ellipse(aes(group = Workflow), type = "norm", linetype = "dashed", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
   scale_color_manual(values = c(
   "Full-length ITS" = "deeppink",
   "ITS2" = "orange")) + 
   scale_fill_manual(values = c(
   "Full-length ITS" = "deeppink",
   "ITS2" = "orange")) +
   theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
   theme(
     panel.grid = element_blank(),
     legend.position = "right",
     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
   )

paired_ordination + geom_line(aes(group = PairID),color = "grey60", alpha = 0.4)
```
